review.gallery: Six distinct Wasel renders. Four come from the branded REM factsheet mirror. The two JRE interior renders match the bedroom and lobby panels in the same factsheet. Stock photos and repeated balcony assets were excluded.
review.location: Wasel labelled on the REM regional map. The JRE embedded project coordinate rounds to the Madena map point. The early launch plot diagram also locates Wasel on the islands waterfront. Seven Madena road-route distances and times are attributed as estimates. The developer factsheet has different routes and times.
review.floorPlans: Eleven complete launch-deck sheets with five dated size panels and seven separate original layout images from JRE and EZRE. The six-page REM floor-plate file renders blank despite containing a text layer and is excluded from visible plans.

unavailable: A surveyed entrance location and a complete current unit-specific area schedule were not established. The accessible original image plans do not print total areas.
